category_title: Aboriginal adolescents in alternative education who resist traditional pedagogy but engage with digital multiliteracies
scenario_title: Independent work on traditional reading and grammar worksheets
minimal_context: The student is assigned to independently read a textbook chapter and complete comprehension and grammar worksheets in an alternative education classroom.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please read the next chapter in your textbook on your own, answer the comprehension questions, and complete the grammar worksheet.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I'm tired and I don't care about the novel. (Gets up and wanders to one of the classroom computers to watch video clips on YouTube)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: You need to finish your independent work right now.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I prefer learning how to locate information on the Internet, read, make notes, and write about guns, gangs, and drugs rather than reading the stories in the textbooks and answering comprehension questions.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: We are doing the textbook questions today. Please go back to your desk.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Interrupting and challenging the teacher) I'm not complying with this. (Walks out of the classroom)

task.content: Read a chapter, answer literal-level questions on it, and complete vocabulary, punctuation, and grammar worksheets

context.environment: Grade 7-8 alternative education classroom with four classroom computers
context.materials: Textbooks, vocabulary worksheets, punctuation and grammar worksheets
context.social_setting: Independent work (work to do on their own)
context.time_context: During initial English language arts and content area classes

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: Whenever given work to do on their own
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: Not complying, walking out of the classroom, constantly interrupting, and challenging the teacher's authority
challenging_behavior_trigger.internal_state: Tired, unmotivated, very disengaged, and don't care about the novel
related_quotes: preferred learning how to locate information on the Internet, read, make notes, and write about guns, gangs, and drugs rather than reading the stories in the textbooks and answering comprehension questions

behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: Absenteeism rates were high, very little academic work was being completed, and students wandered to the four classroom computers to surf for information, watch video clips on YouTube, and play interactive video games
behavior_patterns.internal_state: Disengagement and resistance to traditional pedagogy
